prompt: Create a premium 4:5 monochrome editorial poster using the uploaded image as the subject reference. Preserve the subject’s identity and key features while changing the pose naturally. Use high-contrast black-and-white stencil/ink art, halftone grain, rough brush strokes, ink splashes, distressed paper and photocopy textures. Place the subject dynamically on the right with strong negative space. Add bold condensed “MAVERICK AI” typography on the left, large handwritten “Maverick” brush lettering, minimal technical graphics, crosshairs, geometric lines, microtext, and motivational phrases. Swiss editorial design blended with luxury streetwear and underground graphic-art aesthetics, dramatic lighting, sharp facial details, balanced hierarchy, gallery-quality finish, ultra-high resolution.

promptZh: 使用上传的图片作为主体参考，创作一张优质的 4:5 黑白时尚海报。在保持主体身份和关键特征的同时，自然地改变姿势。采用高对比度的黑白模板/水墨艺术、半色调颗粒、粗犷的笔触、墨迹飞溅、做旧纸张和复印纹理。将主体动态地放置在右侧，并留出强烈的负空间。在左侧添加粗体压缩的 “MAVERICK AI” 排版，大型手写 “Maverick” 笔刷字体，极简的技术图形、十字准线、几何线条、微缩文字和励志短语。瑞士排版设计与奢华街头潮流及地下平面艺术美学相结合，戏剧性的光影，清晰的面部细节，平衡的视觉层级，画廊级品质，超高分辨率。
